features.title: LampArray Basics
features.expected: Radio buttons Off / All green / Gradient / Highlight WASD, a Brightness slider (0-100), an Apply button, and an 'Attached LampArrays: N' summary line. RGB lighting operations of Windows.Devices.Lights.LampArray.

features.title: LampArray Effects
features.expected: Effect-playback controls Pause / Play / Stop, an ImageBitmap image surface, and the 'Attached LampArrays: N' summary. Demonstrates RGB lighting effects via Windows.Devices.Lights.Effects APIs.
